# Invalid argument counts, option values, and unsupported flags return errors.
exec tuck$exe init
exec tuck$exe add 'Argument target' --state todo

! exec tuck$exe init extra
stderr 'init takes no positional arguments'
! exec tuck$exe sync extra
stderr 'sync takes no positional arguments'
! exec tuck$exe check extra
stderr 'check takes no positional arguments'

! exec tuck$exe add
stderr 'add requires a title'
! exec tuck$exe list one two
stderr 'list accepts at most one state'
! exec tuck$exe list someday
stderr 'invalid state "someday"'
! exec tuck$exe list --state todo
stderr '--state is not supported for this command'
! exec tuck$exe list --limit 0
stderr '--limit must be a positive integer'
! exec tuck$exe list --limit nope
stderr '--limit must be a positive integer'
! exec tuck$exe show
stderr 'show requires one task number or ID'
! exec tuck$exe show 001 extra
stderr 'show requires one task number or ID'

! exec tuck$exe find
stderr 'find requires a query'
! exec tuck$exe find word --recent --state todo
stderr '--recent can only be combined with --state done'
! exec tuck$exe find word --meta
stderr '--meta requires a value'
! exec tuck$exe find word --meta broken
stderr '--meta must be KEY=JSON-value'
! exec tuck$exe find word --meta '=1'
stderr '--meta must be KEY=JSON-value'
! exec tuck$exe find word --meta 'priority='
stderr '--meta must be KEY=JSON-value'
! exec tuck$exe find word --meta id=1
stderr '--meta cannot filter reserved field "id"'
! exec tuck$exe find word --meta 'priority=not-json'
stderr 'invalid --meta JSON value'
! exec tuck$exe find word --before other
stderr 'reorder placement options are only supported by reorder'

! exec tuck$exe recent anything
stderr 'recent takes no positional arguments'
! exec tuck$exe recent --limit -1
stderr '--limit must be a positive integer'
! exec tuck$exe recent --meta key=1
stderr '--meta is not supported for this command'

! exec tuck$exe start
stderr 'start requires one task number or ID'
! exec tuck$exe start 001 extra
stderr 'start requires one task number or ID'
! exec tuck$exe done
stderr 'done requires one task number or ID'
! exec tuck$exe reopen
stderr 'reopen requires one task number or ID'
! exec tuck$exe move 001
stderr 'move requires a task number or ID and a state'
! exec tuck$exe move 001 nowhere
stderr 'invalid state "nowhere"'
! exec tuck$exe move 001 todo extra
stderr 'move requires a task number or ID and a state'
! exec tuck$exe rename 001
stderr 'rename requires a task number or ID and a title'
! exec tuck$exe rename 001 ''
stderr 'task title cannot be empty'

! exec tuck$exe meta
stderr 'meta requires get, set, or unset and a task handle'
! exec tuck$exe meta unknown 001
stderr 'unknown metadata operation "unknown"'
! exec tuck$exe meta get 001 one two
stderr 'meta get accepts an optional key'
! exec tuck$exe meta set 001 key
stderr 'meta set requires a task, key, and one JSON value'
! exec tuck$exe meta unset 001
stderr 'meta unset requires a task and key'

! exec tuck$exe add title --limit 1
stderr '--limit is not supported for this command'
! exec tuck$exe list --first
stderr 'reorder placement options are only supported by reorder'

! exec tuck$exe add title --state
stderr '--state requires a value'
! exec tuck$exe add title --state=
stderr '--state requires a value'
! exec tuck$exe list --limit
stderr '--limit requires a value'
! exec tuck$exe find word --meta=
stderr '--meta must be KEY=JSON-value'
! exec tuck$exe reorder 001 --before
stderr '--before requires a value'
! exec tuck$exe reorder 001 --after=
stderr '--after requires a value'
! exec tuck$exe list --limit=-2
stderr '--limit must be a positive integer'
